title: Injection-Safe Shell Quoting
prompt: Implement `shellQuote` so the output, when passed to `sh -c 'printf %s '<quoted>''`, always yields exactly the original argument — for every hostile input in the battery.

tests.name: quoting battery
tests.hint: Wrap in single quotes; replace each embedded ' with '\'' (close, escaped quote, reopen). Nothing else needs transformation — that is the whole safe surface.
